transcript: Speaker A: ये कैसे लगाया था तूने AC? मेरा कितना नुकसान हो गया! [How did you install this AC? Look at how much damage I suffered!] Speaker B: Sir, this is not my mistake. The bracket was fixed correctly, but the wall is hollow, made of very cheap material, so it couldn't hold the weight. I'm not careless, sir. Speaker A: Oh, you speak English? Speaker B: थोड़ी बहुत सर। [A little bit, sir.] Speaker A: हाँ हाँ ठीक है। कहाँ से सीखी इतनी अच्छी English? [Yes, yes, okay. Where did you learn such good English?] Speaker B: ₹1 के trial से सर, English Seekho app पे। काम के बीच दिन का 15 minute हूँ रोज़। App में experts के मजेदार videos हैं जो Hindi में समझाते हैं और English सिखाते हैं। और एक AI coach है 24 घंटे, दिशा मैम, उनके साथ chat पे practice करके English सुधारता हूँ। 100 बार गलत बोलो, सुधार देगी, कभी judge नहीं करती। कभी नहीं बोलती मिस्त्री हो तुमसे नहीं होगा। और सच बताऊँ सर, आजकल English ना बोलो तो कोई इज़्ज़त ही नहीं देता, इसलिए सीखना पड़ा। [From a ₹1 trial, sir, on the English Seekho app. I spend 15 minutes a day during work. The app has fun videos by experts who explain in Hindi and teach English. And there's a 24-hour AI coach, Disha Mam, I practice chatting with her to improve my English. Even if you make a mistake 100 times, she corrects you and never judges. She never says 'you are a technician, you can't do this'. And to be honest, sir, nowadays if you don't speak English, no one respects you, so I had to learn.] Speaker A: App महंगी होगी ना? [The app must be expensive, right?] Speaker B: बिलकुल नहीं सर, ₹1 का trial। और जब से थोड़ी English आ गई, society वालों के सीधे calls आते हैं, काम ज़्यादा मिलता है। महीने के 10,000 तक ज़्यादा कमा लेता हूँ। काम वही, बस इज़्ज़त और rate दोनों बढ़ गए। [Not at all, sir, ₹1 trial. And ever since I learned a bit of English, I get direct calls from society members, I get more work. I earn up to 10,000 more per month. Same work, but both respect and rates have increased.] Speaker A: नाम क्या बताया app का? [What did you say the app's name was?] Speaker B: English Seekho. Voiceover: तो install button पे click करो और English Seekho app download करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: An AC technician surprises an angry customer by explaining his mistake in fluent English. He credits his skills to the English Seekho app's ₹1 trial, which offers Hindi-to-English lessons and a non-judgmental AI chat coach. He shares that learning English has boosted his respect and monthly income by ₹10,000, prompting the customer to ask for the app.
